answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the oasis queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 968 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wander. The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
